# Strategy Rules (auto-generated)

Mirror of the active rows in the `strategy_rules` table of
`data/agent_memory/decisions.db`, rewritten by `agents/reflection_agent.py`
whenever it adds a rule.

**Not injected into prompts.** `config.AGENT_INJECT_LEARNED_RULES` is off
(2026-09-26): the seven 2025-26 rules that were here came from 2-4 gameweeks
of a single backtest entry and let the LLM override the engine's pick. They
remain in the database; nothing was deleted.

No rules for 2026-27.
